prompt: Design the playlist architecture for AlphaTraderTV (the channel currently has only 3 unstructured playlists). Recommend 6 keyword-targeted playlists, an end-screen strategy, and per-video placement and end-card recommendations for the iron condor October P&L video.
raw_output:
Six playlists cover the three primary search lanes (Beginner Options, Monthly Income, Earnings Plays) plus three secondary lanes (Iron Condor Deep Dive, Risk Management, Market Recaps). Each playlist title is a high-volume keyword phrase to capture YouTube search and playlist-tab traffic. End-screen strategy follows a 'one continuation video + one playlist' pattern: the continuation goes to the most-watched-next video from the same persona cohort, the playlist routes to a related evergreen series.

For the iron condor October P&L video specifically, primary placement is at the top of the 'Monthly Options Income' playlist and as #4 in 'Iron Condor Deep Dive' (after the three foundational explainers). End cards point to the 'What is an Iron Condor?' beginner explainer (highest semantic match for cold viewers who clicked through from suggested) and the 'Monthly Options Income' playlist.

playlists.title: Beginner Options: Start Here
playlists.purpose: Subscriber funnel — convert browse traffic to series watchers

structured_output.end_screen_strategy: One continuation video (highest semantic next-watch match) + one playlist (related evergreen). 20-second end-screen window. No 'subscribe' button — replaced by the playlist CTA which historically out-performs.

recommended_end_cards.target: What is an Iron Condor? (Full Explainer)
